name: snaptritor-collector-native
description: Windows-only native automation (window-finding, screen capture, simulated input) and the Electron status window. Installed and run exclusively via Windows' own npm/node (over the repo's UNC path), never via WSL's pnpm -- see CLAUDE.md. Deliberately NOT a pnpm-workspace member: packages/collector/native is nested a level deeper than pnpm-workspace.yaml's 'packages/*' glob matches, so a WSL-side pnpm install never touches it and can't overwrite its Windows-compiled native bindings with Linux ones.
